🌽：梅露的事情發生後，能夠打起精神來配信都是因為有著🌸☄️兩人的陪伴，小學堂那天她們也一起早到安慰著我，之後三人也有再一起出去玩，真的很感謝mcmt。

🌽：After what happened to Mel, I was able to pull myself together and stream all because 🌸☄️ were here with me. They arrived early on the day of the elementary school academic assessment to comfort me. We three went out a few times after as well. I am grateful for mcmt.彗醬畫的hololive JP一期生。2019年6月18日。
